subtitle: Academic review of histopathology images with AI
uploadHint: PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WEBP. Maximum 15 MB.
dragImage: Drag an image here or click to choose one.
dropImage: Drop the image to upload it
resultContext: Model output for the uploaded image
emptyResult: Upload an image and run the analysis to see the model result.
noModels: No models are available in the backend.
invalidFile: The file must be a PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WEBP image.
fileTooLarge: The image exceeds the 15 MB limit.
connectionError: Could not connect to FastAPI. Start the backend and try again.
api400: The image or selected model is invalid.
api413: The image exceeds the allowed limit.
api415: The uploaded file is not a supported image.
api503: The model is not currently available.
apiError: The request could not be completed. Check the backend.
supportNotice: This system is academic support and does not replace a healthcare professional's evaluation.
legacyNoticeBody: These values come from the original Streamlit application and do not represent a new reproducible evaluation.
analysisUnavailable: No legacy data is available for the selected model.
trainingPlotUnavailable: The legacy training chart is not available in the workspace.
explanationNotice: The map shows regions that influenced the model. It does not confirm a lesion or replace professional evaluation.
api422: The request cannot be processed with the current model or parameters. For Grad-CAM, some models may not be compatible.
workflowUploadBody: Select a valid histopathology image for analysis.
workflowModelBody: Use the recommended model or compare with another available model.
workflowResultBody: Review class, confidence, probabilities, explanatory map, and PDF.
clinicalReadingBody: Review the predicted class together with confidence and probability distribution. Low confidence or close probabilities across classes require careful interpretation.
gradCamUnavailable: The explanatory map is not available for this model. Use the recommended model or check the FastAPI detail.
clinicalConsoleBody: Analyze one image, review model confidence, compare probabilities, and generate a documented academic report.
imageQualityBody: Use sharp images without overlaid annotations and in a supported format. Input quality directly affects model output.
modelSelectionBody: The recommended model is the main reference. Other models may help compare academic outputs.
reviewAndReportBody: Review result, confidence, alternatives, and explanatory map before downloading the report.
uploadPanelBody: Upload one histopathology image for analysis.
modelPanelBody: Select the model and run inference in FastAPI.
confidenceHighNote: The output is consistent for the main class, always as academic support.
confidenceModerateNote: Review close alternatives and consider checking another model.
confidenceLowNote: The output is uncertain; it requires careful review and must not be used as a conclusion.
noGradCamYet: Generate an explanatory map when you want to review regions that influenced the model.
medicalDisclaimerBody: This system does not issue a clinical diagnosis. Every result must be reviewed by qualified healthcare staff.
